note: Logic gates, not prose. Each gate is: when (conditions on measured state) -> then (an ordered action chain), with the owner's own words as `why` so the reason survives. gates.py evaluates these in priority order against a state dict read off the bridge and hands the autopilot ONE chain, so the model looks up instead of re-reasoning. Lower priority number fires first.
